#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Read-only TS-740 acceptance check. Run only on delta, beta or mariogk-dev:
#   nice -n 19 bash scripts/check-dashboard-netbird
# Requires bash, getent, timeout, nc, curl, jq, oci and netbird.
# Never starts a browser, logs in to NetBird or connects to an operator desktop.
# Uses the operator's OCI config; tokens are never printed or passed in argv.
set +x
set -euo pipefail
umask 077

case $(hostname -s) in
	delta|beta|mariogk-dev) ;;
	*) printf 'Run only on delta, beta or mariogk-dev.\n' >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac

read -r -a netbird_command <<< "${NB:-netbird}"
for tool in getent timeout nc curl jq oci base64 ip "${netbird_command[0]}"; do
	command -v "$tool" >/dev/null || { printf 'Missing prerequisite: %s\n' "$tool" >&2; exit 2; }
done
scratch=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf -- "$scratch"' EXIT
trap 'exit 130' INT
trap 'exit 143' TERM

token_header() {
	local region=$1 vault=$2 secret=$3 token
	if ! token=$(timeout 30 oci --region "$region" secrets secret-bundle get-secret-bundle-by-name \
		--vault-id "$vault" --secret-name "$secret" \
		--query 'data."secret-bundle-content".content' --raw-output 2>/dev/null | base64 --decode 2>/dev/null); then
		printf 'Vault token unavailable: %s\n' "$secret" >&2
		return
	fi
	# Reject control characters and curl header injection; do not echo the value.
	if [[ -z $token || $token == *[[:space:][:cntrl:]]* ]]; then
		printf 'Vault token invalid: %s\n' "$secret" >&2
		return
	fi
	printf 'Authorization: Bearer %s\n' "$token" > "$scratch/$secret.header"
}

http_check() {
	local url=$1 header=${2:-} status nodes remote expected=${3:-} pin=${4:-}
	local name=$5 via=$6 ipv6=$7 interface=${8:-}
	local args=(--disable --silent --noproxy '*' --connect-timeout 3 --max-time 10 --output "$scratch/body" --write-out '%{http_code} %{remote_ip}')
	if [[ -n $header ]]; then
		[[ -s $header ]] || { printf 'NO-TOKEN'; return; }
		[[ -n $interface ]] || { printf 'TRANSPORT-FAIL'; return; }
		args+=(--interface "if!$interface")
		# Pin only after native DNS validation; never re-resolve with a token.
		[[ -z $pin ]] || args+=(--resolve "$name:9463:$pin")
		args+=(--header "@$header" --header 'Accept: application/json')
	fi
	if ! status=$(curl "${args[@]}" "$url" 2>/dev/null); then
		printf 'CONNECT-FAIL'; return
	else
		remote=${status#* }; status=${status%% *}
		[[ $remote != *:* ]] || remote=$(normalize_ipv6 "$remote")
		if [[ $remote != "$expected" && ! ( $via == name && $remote == "$ipv6" && -n $ipv6 ) ]]; then
			printf 'WRONG-PEER'; return
		fi
		printf '%s' "$remote" > "$scratch/remote"
	fi
	if [[ $status != 200 ]]; then
		printf 'HTTP-%s' "$status"
	elif [[ -z $header ]]; then
		printf 'PASS'
	# TS-740 explicitly requires JSON with nodes. The existing HTML route is
	# an acceptance failure for TS-740, even when its HTTP status is 200.
	elif nodes=$(jq -er -s 'if length == 1 and (.[0] | type) == "object" and (.[0].nodes | type) == "array" and (.[0].nodes | length) > 0 then .[0].nodes | length else error("missing nodes") end' "$scratch/body" 2>/dev/null); then
		printf 'PASS(%s nodes)' "$nodes"
	else
		printf 'HTTP-200/INVALID-JSON'
	fi
}

normalize_ipv6() {
	local address=${1%%/*}
	[[ $address == *:* && $address != *[!0-9a-fA-F:.]* ]] || return 0
	# getent formats numeric addresses canonically, just like DNS answers.
	timeout 5 getent ahostsv6 "$address" 2>/dev/null | awk '$2 == "STREAM" && /:/ && !/^::ffff:/ {print $1; exit}' || true
}

transport_ok() {
	local address=$1 interface=$2
	[[ -n $interface ]] || return 1
	timeout 5 ip -j route get "$address" 2>/dev/null | jq -e --arg interface "$interface" \
		'length == 1 and .[0].dev == $interface' >/dev/null 2>&1
}

printf 'Dashboard NetBird check: %s; source: %s\n\n' "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" "$(hostname)"
if ! timeout 10 "${netbird_command[@]}" status --json > "$scratch/peers.json" 2>/dev/null; then
	printf '{}\n' > "$scratch/peers.json"
	printf 'NetBird peer inventory unavailable; authenticated requests will be skipped.\n' >&2
fi
client_ip=$(jq -er 'select(.daemonStatus == "Connected") | .netbirdIp | split("/")[0]' "$scratch/peers.json" 2>/dev/null || true)
nb_interface=
if [[ -n $client_ip ]]; then
	nb_interface=$(timeout 5 ip -d -j addr show 2>/dev/null | jq -er --arg ip "$client_ip" \
		'[.[] | select(any(.addr_info[]?; .local == $ip))] | if length == 1 and .[0].linkinfo.info_kind == "wireguard" then .[0].ifname else empty end' 2>/dev/null || true)
fi
printf 'Token transport interface: %s\n\n' "${nb_interface:-UNVERIFIED}"
token_header sa-saopaulo-1 \
	ocid1.vault.oc1.sa-saopaulo-1.ffvmfu2naagt6.abtxeljr7ebplea4ua3memgthsupcfn3crg6d56vipsw7o2butchdrx3urmq gru-1-orch-dashboard-token
token_header us-sanjose-1 \
	ocid1.vault.oc1.us-sanjose-1.grvmmkplaacx6.abzwuljrzcofqki6a5podtjnhvyiol7yqehrd77tp2hoeynxp5wozv54mq6a sfo-1-orch-dashboard-token

printf '| Controller | A | AAAA | Via | Address | TCP 9463 | /healthz | /topology JSON | Result |\n'
printf '|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|\n'
failed=0 rows=0
while read -r controller ipv4; do
	name="$controller.nb.ts.internal"
	a=$(timeout 5 getent ahostsv4 "$name" 2>/dev/null | awk '$2 == "STREAM" {print $1}' | sort -u || true)
	aaaa=$(timeout 5 getent ahostsv6 "$name" 2>/dev/null | awk '$2 == "STREAM" && /:/ && !/^::ffff:/ {print $1}' | sort -u || true)
	peer=$(jq -er --arg ip "$ipv4" --arg name "$name" \
		'[.peers.details[] | select(.fqdn == $name and (.netbirdIp | split("/")[0]) == $ip)] | if length == 1 then .[0] else empty end' \
		"$scratch/peers.json" 2>/dev/null || true)

	ipv6=$(jq -r '.netbirdIpv6 // empty' <<< "$peer" 2>/dev/null || true)
	aaaa=$(while read -r answer; do
		canonical=$(normalize_ipv6 "$answer")
		printf '%s\n' "${canonical:-INVALID}"
	done <<< "$aaaa" | sort -u)
	ipv6=$(normalize_ipv6 "$ipv6")
	dns4=FAIL dns6=FAIL controller_failed=0
	[[ $a == "$ipv4" ]] && dns4=PASS
	[[ -n $ipv6 && $aaaa == "$ipv6" ]] && dns6=PASS
	region=${controller#ts-}; region=${region%-*}
	for via in IPv4 IPv6 name; do
		rows=$((rows + 1))
		family=()
		case $via in
			IPv4) address=$ipv4; authority=$ipv4; family=(-4) ;;
			IPv6) address=${ipv6:-MISSING}; authority="[$address]"; family=(-6) ;;
			name) address=$name; authority=$name ;;
		esac
		tcp=FAIL health=MISSING topology=MISSING result=FAIL
		expected=$address; [[ $via != name ]] || expected=$ipv4
		if [[ $address != MISSING ]]; then
			if timeout 5 nc "${family[@]}" -z -w 3 "$address" 9463 >/dev/null 2>&1; then tcp=PASS; fi

				topology=IDENTITY-FAIL

				if [[ $via == name ]]; then
					auth_address=$(cat "$scratch/remote")
					pin=$auth_address
					[[ $pin != *:* ]] || pin="[$pin]"
				fi
				if transport_ok "$auth_address" "$nb_interface"; then
					topology=$(http_check "http://$authority:9463/topology" "$scratch/$region-1-orch-dashboard-token.header" "$expected" "$pin" "$name" "$via" "$ipv6" "$nb_interface")
				else
					topology=TRANSPORT-FAIL
				fi
			fi
		fi
		if [[ $dns4 == PASS && $dns6 == PASS && $tcp == PASS && $health == PASS && $topology == PASS\(* ]]; then
			result=PASS
		else
			failed=$((failed + 1)); controller_failed=1
		fi
		printf '| %s | %s | %s | %s | %s | %s | %s | %s | %s |\n' \
			"$controller" "$dns4" "$dns6" "$via" "$address" "$tcp" "$health" "$topology" "$result"
	done
	if ((controller_failed)); then
		# Capture one read-only listener diagnostic per failing controller.
		printf 'Expected IPv4: %s; inventory identity: %s.\n' "$ipv4" "$identity" > "$scratch/$controller.listen"
		if ! timeout 15 "${netbird_command[@]}" ssh --no-browser "root@$ipv4" \
			'ss -ltnp | grep 9463' </dev/null >> "$scratch/$controller.listen" 2>/dev/null; then
			printf 'Listener query failed (SSH authentication, timeout or no 9463 listener).\n' >> "$scratch/$controller.listen"
		fi
	fi
done <<'CONTROLLERS'
ts-gru-1 10.200.87.215
ts-gru-2 10.200.38.135
ts-gru-3 10.200.168.164
ts-sfo-1 10.200.112.213
ts-sfo-2 10.200.122.37
ts-sfo-3 10.200.63.195
CONTROLLERS

for listen in "$scratch"/*.listen; do
	[[ -f $listen ]] || continue
	controller=${listen##*/}; controller=${controller%.listen}
	printf '\n%s remote listen address (NetBird SSH):\n```text\n' "$controller"
	cat "$listen"
	printf '```\n'
done
printf '\nResult: %s/%s acceptance rows passed.\n' "$((rows - failed))" "$rows"
((failed == 0))
